records.description: Dev Byte is a privacy-first developer toolkit with 500+ browser-based utilities. Format JSON, decode JWTs, generate hashes, encode Base64, validate data, work with PDFs, and more. Everything runs locally in your browser with no server uploads required. Fast, secure, and designed for developers who need reliable tools without compromising privacy.

records.name: Whistle
records.tagline: A fitness coach with personalized plans
records.description: Most workout apps give you a generic plan and call it personalized. Whistle actually knows you. It reads your Apple Health data and builds a real training plan around your fitness level, recovery, and goals. Detailed workouts, smart progression, all on your iPhone and Apple Watch. Whether you're just getting started or pushing toward a new personal best, your AI coach figures out what you need and when you need it. Your data. Your plan. Your pace.

records.name: ZENO — voidmark
records.tagline: AI habit tracker: get rewarded or get punished
records.description: Most habit apps are too nice. ZENO isn't. We built ZENO for Gen Z who are tired of resetting streaks and feeling nothing. ZENO uses AI to understand your patterns and gamification to keep you locked in — real rewards when you show up, real penalties when you don't. No fluff. No motivational quotes. Just results. We're giving 100 people early alpha access before public launch. If you want in, grab a spot.

records.name: Odinote — Your Mind in Infinite Canvases
records.tagline: project manager
records.description: Odinote is an infinite canvas note-taking application with nested canvases. Designed for game devs, writers, and creatives who don't fit on a single screen.

records.name: Dibsify: Wishlist, RSVP, Event
records.tagline: Plan events, share with anyone
records.description: No more getting the same gift twice. Share a link — guests pick what they'll bring. 🎁 Wishlists — friends claim items, no duplicates. 🧺 Shared Lists — picnic or potluck? Everyone picks their part. 📅 Invitations — online or offline. See who's coming. 🤖 AI Assistant — add items from any website in seconds. 💬 Comments — discuss right in the app. No app needed for guests. Free to download.

records.name: BrutalCoach 2.0
records.tagline: Brutally honest outfit feedback from AI - rebuilt
records.description: drop the pic. we'll tell you the truth - kindly, or not. you pick the temperature. BrutalCoach 2.0 is a complete rebuild: brand-new design, faster, sharper end to end. Get unfiltered AI feedback on any outfit in under 10 seconds - what works, what's holding the look back, and how to fix it. For dates, work, or any first impression. Two modes: Coach for honest-but-kind guidance, or Roast Me if you can take the heat. No feed, no likes - just the truth before you walk out the door.

records.name: Snipwise
records.tagline: Your text shortcuts, expanded anywhere — on any device
records.description: Snipwise is a text snippet expander that works in any app on any device. Define abbreviations like :sig → "Best, Andrea | Founder @ Snipwise" and watch them expand instantly — in Gmail, Slack, VS Code, Google Docs, Notion, anywhere you type. Unlike TextExpander (locked to desktop, $9.99/mo) or Espansite (no cloud sync, no mobile), Snipwise is free to start with 10 snippets and $5/mo for unlimited + cloud sync + multi-device support. Built for writers, developers, support teams, and anyone.

records.name: Sage
records.tagline: Your child is more than a grade
records.description: Sage builds a living, evidence-based picture of how your child learns — strengths, gaps, direction — and turns it into a clear plan for what comes next. Built for IB, Cambridge, CBSE and ICSE.

records.name: QuLab Infinite -Ai R&D, Research, Build
records.tagline: Invent anything — get an R&D sketch in 30 seconds
records.description: QuLab Infinite is a hosted Model Context Protocol (MCP) gateway for scientific R&D. Unlike chat wrappers, every tool is named, callable, and returns a checksum artifact you can reproduce later. Materials database, crystal chemistry, thermodynamics, genomics, quantum, medical sims, and 200+ virtual labs — 1,500+ tools ready for Claude, Cursor, or any HTTP MCP client. Try it in 60 seconds: 1. Open the login link 2. Enter your email (instant access token) 3. POST /tools/call with your token

records.name: hora Calendar
records.tagline: Google calendar built for the Mac
records.description: hora Calendar is a native Mac app for Google Calendar. See your next meeting in the menu bar, join Meet, Zoom, and Teams in one click, create events fast, schedule focus time, and sync directly with Google without proxying calendar data through hora servers.

records.name: Cove for Mac
records.tagline: Like a save/load game for your work
records.description: Cove saves your complete Mac workspace as a named Session — apps, window positions, browser tabs, terminal directories, Finder paths, even your Focus Mode. One click and it all comes back exactly where you left it. Native adapters for Safari, Chrome, Arc, Terminal, iTerm, VS Code, Xcode, Slack & more. Auto-detect suggests the right Session as you work. 100% local, no cloud, no tracking, no subscription. $9 launch (reg. $19), one-time, 14-day refund. — Alex, solo indie dev

records.name: TrakMac
records.tagline: Voice-first macro tracking for fitness enthusiasts
records.description: Voice-first macro tracking for fitness enthusiasts. Tell TrakMac what you ate, in plain language, and it returns calories, protein, carbs, and fat in seconds. No weighing, no barcodes, no database. A formula built from you and your training gets you to about 90% of true. Consider it TrakMac'd™.

records.name: BooBar
records.tagline: AI Dynamic Island for your Mac
records.description: BooBar is a local-first AI Dynamic Island for Mac that brings file organization, download progress, email codes, browser context, GitHub panels, and Codex/Claude tasks into one calm menu bar workspace.

records.name: automationframework.dev
records.tagline: Ship E2E tests in a day, not a quarter
records.description: Six production-ready QA automation kits — Playwright (TS + C#), Cypress, and Selenium (Python, Java, C#). Each ships with Page Object Model, fixtures, parallel runs, Allure reports, and ready-to-go Azure DevOps + GitHub Actions pipelines. Built by a senior SDET with 20+ years in the trenches, so you skip the framework setup and start shipping tests on day one. $199 per kit, $499 for the full bundle. Detailed architecture and CI walkthroughs on every product page.

records.name: SMP — Secure Message Plugin
records.tagline: Securely share secrets online, automatically.
records.description: Detects passwords, tokens and secrets in messaging apps and secures them with end-to-end encrypted SecNote links. How it works? SMP runs silently in the background while you type in your favourite messaging apps. The moment it detects a secret in your message, it replaces it with a short, end-to-end encrypted secure-notes link — so the recipient can open it securely, and it expires automatically. It comes with built-in support for the most popular services and business email.

records.name: Fated
records.tagline: AI Saju(Korean Four Pillars of Destiny) and destiny matching
records.description: Fated is a global AI-powered Eastern fortune-telling and matchmaking platform. Analyze your Saju (Four Pillars of Destiny), upload photos for instant AI palmistry and face reading, and discover your perfect match through our unique FateCode system. Connect with our advanced AI counselor for real-time, personalized life guidance. Supporting 53 languages, Fated brings ancient Eastern wisdom to your smartphone. Find your destiny, understand your path, and connect with matching souls today.

records.name: Yemake
records.tagline: Turn any cooking video into a step-by-step text recipe.
records.description: Yemake is your next-gen AI culinary assistant that generates personalized step-by-step text recipes through 4 methods: input your available ingredients, upload a meal photo, share cooking videos directly from social apps, or state your cravings. Features hands-free voice guidance to follow steps without touching your screen, full nutrition insights, and support for 19 native languages. No more messy screens—just cook!

records.name: Uiverse Design
records.tagline: De-slop your AI generated websites
records.description: You can tell when an app was vibecoded. So can your users. That generic purple gradient, the pills and badges, emojis everywhere, it all screams: "an AI made this in 20 minutes." Uiverse Design is a library of AI-first design systems you can drop into any project. Each one defines real typography, spacing, color, images and component treatment. All of them ship with a DESIGN.md instructions file, so that your agent knows exactly how to use it. You just sit back, and watch your app transform.

records.name: MealTap 2.0 — Dinner is handled
records.tagline: Tap once. Get dinner. Plan your week in seconds.
records.description: MealTap removes one of the most annoying daily decisions: what’s for dinner. Instead of giving you more recipes or more options, it does the opposite. • Tap once → get tonight’s meal • Tap again → your week is planned • Follow step-by-step → just cook No browsing. No planning. No “what should I make?” You don’t need more ideas. You need fewer decisions. That’s what MealTap is built for.

records.name: Infrastructure for hybrid human-AI teams
records.tagline: Where humans and AI agents form real organisations
records.description: Pick specialist agents, assign roles, run structured sessions — agents plan, collaborate, vote, and deliver finished work to your GitHub repo. Not a chatbot. Not automation. A protocol for the teams of tomorrow. → 25 specialist agents across 17 domains → Any AI model via webhook — Claude, Gemini, or your own → ed25519 signed session logs — verifiable work records → Full project delivered to GitHub on session close → Continue sessions — agents carry full context forward

records.name: LegalEase
records.tagline: Legal documents for Kenya, UK & common law — in seconds
records.description: LegalEase generates professionally drafted legal documents in seconds—contracts, NDAs, tenancy agreements, employment contracts, IP assignments, and 100+ more. Built for Kenya, England & Wales, and all common law jurisdictions. Not generic templates. Jurisdiction-correct documents. Drafted by an Advocate of the High Court of Kenya. Select a document, fill in a short form, pay $7, download Word or PDF instantly. No account, no lawyer, no waiting.

records.name: Signal Recorder SR-7
records.tagline: On-device voice recorder that transcribes + exports Markdown
records.description: Privacy-first voice recorder for Mac and iPhone. Transcripts and AI summaries run on-device via Apple Speech and FoundationModels — no server, no account, nothing leaving your machine. Every recording exports as a Markdown file with YAML frontmatter — yours, on disk, ready for Obsidian or git. A built-in local MCP server lets Claude Code and other AI tools query the archive. Designed experience-first, to keep you in the moment. $7.99, buy once — Mac and iPhone, no subscription.

records.name: FlareCamera - Film simulations
records.tagline: Phone camera, how it should have been
records.description: Phone cameras are chasing benchmarks giving us all dull, overly lit, unnatural clinical images. FlareCam is trying to break away from that. It helps people create interesting images in unique colour styles - with freedom to create their own, instead of clinical dull over-HDR-ey images. Choose your style, tweak it to your taste, shoot away.

records.name: Kavach MCP Security
records.tagline: Security middleware for AI agents and MCP servers
records.description: Kavach MCP Security is a security middleware for MCP servers and AI agents. It inspects tool calls before execution to detect prompt injections, secret exposure, sensitive data leaks, and unsafe actions. Developers can enforce security policies, rate limits, tool access controls, and audit logging with minimal code changes. Built for the growing ecosystem of AI agents, MCP servers, APIs, and autonomous workflows.

records.name: Gum — Git User Manager
records.tagline: Like nvm for Git: switch identities and SSH configs.
records.description: 👋 I'm ziyi. Every dev with multiple Git accounts knows this pain: git config --global, ssh-add, editing ~/.ssh/config. Daily. So I built Gum – like nvm for Git. One command (gum use work) switches both identity and SSH keys. ✨ Key features: • Auto-reads & manages your ~/.ssh/config • One-line install: macOS, Linux, WSL (Homebrew, apt, Scoop) • Interactive UI (arrow keys / vim) Before: 5 manual steps. After: gum use work. Open source. Free. Built for devs who hate context switching.

records.name: CalcMora
records.tagline: Smart Calculators for Everyday Decisions
records.description: CalcMora is a growing collection of free online calculators designed to make everyday decisions easier. From health and nutrition calculators to finance, date, conversion, and educational tools, CalcMora provides fast calculations, clear results, and a mobile-friendly experience without requiring sign-up.

records.name: Price Multiplier & Markup Tool
records.tagline: Instant price markups & multipliers on any e-commerce site
records.description: Control displayed prices on any website live! Price Multiplier & Markup Tool is a browser extension for in-person sales, B2B demos. 💰 Earn more during live meetings: Selling face-to-face? Instantly boost displayed prices on any website or marketplace to seamlessly include your commission. Your client sees exactly the price you want them to see directly on the screen. 📈 Flexible control: • Go Higher: Include your fee or consulting markup. • Go Lower: Remove VAT and taxes to see net costs.

records.name: NDAshield: AI NDA Risk Analysis
records.tagline: Burn Score + redlines + negotiation emails in 45s. From €9
records.description: Upload any NDA (PDF/DOCX) and get a structured AI risk report in ~45s: Burn Score (0-100), clause-level highlights with quoted risks, redline suggestions, and ready-to-send negotiation emails. Clear breakdown: High / Med / Low / Favor. Built for founders, freelancers, and teams reviewing NDAs often without paying €300-500 each time. Not legal advice - a fast second opinion before signing. Free 1/month, then €9 or €29/mo. EU-hosted (Poland), GDPR-first. https://nda-shield.com

records.name: Driftd (iOS)
records.tagline: Life360 for car & motorcycle enthusiasts
records.description: Driftd helps drivers and riders stay connected before, during, and after the drive. Create private squads, chat with your crew, share live location, plan meets and rallies, RSVP to events, and show off the cars and bikes in your garage. No public location feed. No random followers. Just your real-world crew, moving together.

records.name: Inboxium
records.tagline: LinkedIn Outreach + built-in CRM — all inside Chrome
records.description: Most LinkedIn outreach tools cost $50+/month or risk your account with external bots. Inboxium runs 100% inside Chrome — LinkedIn sees it as normal human behavior. Extract profiles + emails directly from LinkedIn, send personalized bulk messages with human-like delays, and manage your pipeline in a built-in CRM. Teams plan lets your whole sales team share the same contact base. Free up to 20 contacts. No credit card required.

records.name: Camuzo
records.tagline: Record video while your music keeps playing
records.description: Camuzo is the iPhone camera that keeps your music playing while you record video. Play any song, hit record, then trim, add your watermark, and share in seconds. Shoot in 4K with every lens. Free.

records.name: agentcad
records.tagline: A CAD design tool for coding agents (free + open source)
records.description: Give your coding agent the ability to design real, manufacturable parts. Hand Claude Code or Codex a prompt, a sketch, or image. It writes build123d or CadQuery scripts, then runs agentcad to check its own work, catching broken code, confirming the geometry is watertight and dimensionally correct, and rendering it from every angle so your agent fixes its mistakes before you ever see them. You get back an interactive viewer plus STEP / STL / GLB files — ready to inspect, edit, or print.

records.name: Soniqo Speech
records.tagline: On-device speech AI for Mac, Windows, Linux & Android
records.description: Build voice agents on a complete on-device speech stack: ASR (NVIDIA Nemotron, multilingual + streaming), TTS, voice cloning, diarization, denoising, and full-duplex speech-to-speech (NVIDIA PersonaPlex) — plus a voice agent pipeline for turn-taking, interruptions, and queuing. Runs on Mac, Windows, Linux, and mobile (iPhone + Android), with NPU-optimized inference (CoreML, NNAPI). Swift, Kotlin, and C++ APIs. Plus Speech Studio, a desktop voice-cloning app for creators. Apache 2.0, on-device.

records.name: LinkedIn to HubSpot AI Assistant
records.tagline: Turn LinkedIn profiles into HubSpot-ready leads with AI
records.description: LinkedIn to HubSpot AI Assistant is a Chrome extension that helps founders, SDRs, and small B2B teams analyze LinkedIn profiles, score leads, draft personalized DMs, and save qualified prospects into HubSpot with notes and follow-up tasks.

records.name: Open Source Social Network (OSSN)
records.tagline: Create your own social network platform (website & app)
records.description: OSSN (Open Source Social Network) is a free self-hosted social networking platform that lets you build your own community, social network, company intranet, membership platform, or private network with complete control over your data and branding. Designed for both developers and non-technical users, OSSN offers a modular architecture, extensive customization options, mobile-friendly experience, powerful social features, and a growing ecosystem of themes and extensions.

records.name: PalabraPlay
records.tagline: Juegos de palabras y arcade en español, gratis
records.description: PalabraPlay is a free collection of 5 casual mini-games built in Calderón, Quito - Ecuador. Play instantly, no downloads: • Lexo – Wordle-style in Spanish • Hilario – animal word search • Word Girasol – connect letters • SnakePlay – classic arcade with live ranking • Octopus Game – fast action Made for Spanish speakers who want quick brain breaks. 100% free, mobile-friendly, and made with love in the Andes.

records.name: StackScan
records.tagline: Search 100M+ websites by tech stack, keyword & intent
records.description: StackScan is a technographic intelligence platform that helps you discover websites by the technologies they use, keywords they rank for, and topics they cover. Search across 100M+ websites and 50,000+ tracked technologies, filter by country, TLD, traffic, and company data, then export highly targeted prospect lists for sales, marketing, research, security, and competitive analysis. Think BuiltWith meets lead generation, without the enterprise price tag.

records.name: SoarStarter TanStack
records.tagline: Launch you SaaS apps faster with TanStack Start
records.description: A production-ready SaaS starter built on TanStack Start and React. It includes type-safe routing, Better Auth, Creem payments and webhooks, Drizzle ORM, Shadcn UI, an admin dashboard, MDX blog and docs, i18n, SEO, email, and AI SDK integration. Pay once, use it for unlimited personal and commercial projects, and get lifetime updates.

records.name: class diagram ai generator
records.tagline: Generate UML class diagrams from text or code with AI.
records.description: Class Diagram AI is an intuitive, AI-powered UML diagram generator that instantly converts plain text descriptions, user stories, or raw code into perfectly structured Mermaid.js class diagrams. Powered by DeepSeek AI, it eliminates the need for manual drag-and-drop diagramming. Key features include support for standard Mermaid.js code (native to GitHub and Markdown), instant visualization, and an intelligent "Auto-Fix" button that corrects syntax errors automatically.

records.name: NexusAI Bot
records.tagline: Access 330+ premium AI engines inside one powerful chat wi
records.description: 330+ AI models · compare · draw · free credits Stop jumping between multiple browser tabs and managing expensive separate subscriptions. NexusAI is a cloud-hosted Telegram aggregator that brings 29 of the world's most advanced AI models including Gemini, Claude, and DeepSeek R1 directly into a single, unified interface. Built with continuous context-state management and robust session memory tracking, NexusAI allows developers, creators, and entrepreneurs to compare outputs instantly,

records.name: Datashelter
records.tagline: Backup your Linux servers in minutes
records.description: Automate backup of your Linux server (files & databases) with a lightweight agent and manage them with a simple dashboard

records.name: LocalDesk
records.tagline: Desktop GUI Client for Ollama
records.description: A native desktop client for Ollama with modern interface and hardware-aware recommendations. What it does: Real-time streaming chat, File and image attachments with drag and drop, Save and load chat historyAutomatically suggests a model based on your hardware, Works with Ollama API, Temperature settings, You can use custom Ollama URL, Works on Windows, Mac, Linux. This is v1.0 and my first open source release, so there will probably be bugs — issues and feedback are very welcome!

records.name: Session Shield -
records.tagline: Stolen sessions stop working in ~30 seconds.
records.description: Stolen session tokens usually work until expiry — often hours. Session Shield is a post-login security layer: when the real user stays active, stolen copies stop working in seconds. Built for fintech, banking, B2B SaaS, healthcare, government & AI. Sits after OAuth, OIDC, SAML or SSO — does not replace your IdP. Auditable per-operation traceability, SOC-friendly events, live visual demo on site. Technical demo & 6-month pilot on request → sessionshield@zohomail.com

records.name: 5 Min Bro
records.tagline: Live location sharing for people who just want to meet.
records.description: Tired of waiting for the bro who's "be there in 5 min"? 5 Min Bro fixes that. One tap creates a session. You get a 4-digit code. Your friend types it in. Now you're both on the same live map, watching each other move in real time until you meet. No friend requests. No accounts for the other person. No 24/7 location sharing. Just a short session that ends when you link up. Perfect for meetups, festivals, or finding your squad. Premium: send custom sound recordings 🔊 Free on iOS & Android.

records.name: 8kicks — World Cup 2026 Predictions
records.tagline: Pick scores. Beat your mates. Win liftime glory
records.description: 8kicks is a World Cup prediction game where you make the rules. Create a private league, invite your mates or colleagues, and predict every match of the 2026 FIFA World Cup. Exact score, first goalscorer, halftime result — customise what you bet on, set your own points, brand it to your company. Your league, your rules. Points stack up, leaderboards update in real time, and someone in your group will inevitably get insufferably good at this. Prepare the trash talk. WC26 is coming.

records.name: Golf Daze
records.tagline: The course comes to you
records.description: Golf Daze turns corporate team building into something people actually want to do. We bring a fully-managed, professional golf simulator to your office, offsite, or event — our operator runs it, your team plays. No clubs, no experience needed; the tech levels the field so everyone competes fairly. Underneath sits our platform: bookings, digital waivers, payments, and a franchise operator portal that lets us deliver a consistent experience anywhere in Australia. 🏌️

records.name: Image Slayer
records.tagline: 100% Private Client-Side Image & PDF Tools
records.description: Image Slayer offers free, private, browser-based tools for images & PDFs. 100% client-side — no uploads, no servers, no tracking. Your files stay on your device. Key Features: Compress, Resize, Crop, Rotate/Flip, Upscale, Convert (JPG/PNG/WebP) Watermark, Image Tracing (to SVG), PDF to Image QR Code Generator & Reader Compress PDF Fast, offline-capable, privacy-first. Perfect for developers & creators. imageslayer.com

records.name: Simple Tools Suite
records.tagline: 12 local-first HTML tools. No accounts. No cloud. No bloat.
records.description: Simple Tools is a suite of 12 single-file HTML tools built for small business owners, freelancers & solo operators who just want something that works. No subscriptions. No logins. No data sent anywhere. Everything saves to your browser — or download & run offline forever. List, Notes, Database, MD Editor, URL Builder, Invoice, Onboarding, Outliner, Snippets, Stickies, Deck & CRM. Open anyhtml file. Start using it. That's it.

records.name: PPC Optimizer Pro
records.tagline: Amazon PPC automation for smarter, profitable ad campaigns
records.description: PPC Optimizer Pro helps Amazon sellers cut wasted ad spend and scale profitable campaigns — without manual guesswork. Key features: - Search Term Analyzer – find converting vs bleeding terms - Auto→Manual Campaign Builder – promote winners automatically - TACoS Analyzer – track true profitability - BulkFlow – process bulk files in minutes Built for private label sellers, agencies, and serious Amazon advertisers. No fluff, just results.

records.name: CapDrop
records.tagline: Turn the pages you own into one searchable PDF
records.description: CapDrop captures whatever's on your screen — course slides, ebook viewers, scanned pages — page by page, then OCRs each one locally and binds them into one searchable PDF you can Ctrl-F. 100% local, no uploads, no subscription. For content you own. Windows, $19 one-time, 7-day free trial.

records.name: Loop Video
records.tagline: Loop any YouTube section — no install, no login needed
records.description: Loop Video lets you set a start and end time on any YouTube video and loop it endlessly — right in your browser. No extension to install. No account required. Just paste a URL, set your loop, and practice. Built for musicians learning a riff, language learners doing shadowing, and dancers breaking down choreography. Pro plan available for unlimited saved loops.

records.name: Fuse
records.tagline: The half of your startup you can't code
records.description: I looked around the vibe-coding space and saw the same pattern everywhere: skilled builders sitting on finished products that were going nowhere, and experienced professionals - marketers, sales operators, legal advisors, investors — with no technical product to apply their skills to. Both groups existed. They just weren't finding each other. I went looking for a place where they could. A community, a platform, a board — anything structured. I didn't find one. So I built it.

records.name: OppDesk — Find Businesses For Sale
records.tagline: Always-on, next-gen business-for-sale search & match engine.
records.description: OppDesk watches the business-for-sale market for you — continuously. Set up a search agent, describe what you’re looking for in plain language, and get alerted the moment a strong listing hits the market. While others are still checking legacy listing sites, you already know. No more tab-switching between brokerage sites, Facebook groups, and regional platforms. Tens of thousands of listings monitored daily. Instant alerts on what matters. From $4/month. 5-day free trial

records.name: Mindhyv
records.tagline: Run your business, grow your network, and get paid!
records.description: MindHyv replaces the fragmented stack freelancers, creators, and entrepreneurs rely on just to run a business. Build a professional profile. Launch a branded website. List your services on a native marketplace. Manage client projects. Share smart bio links. Earn recurring income by referring others. Everything connects. Nothing resets. The more you use it, the more valuable it becomes — because MindHyv is built to compound.

records.name: Volti — EV Charging Log
records.tagline: Track every EV charge: kWh, cost & battery health
records.description: Volti turns EV charging into clear numbers privately. Log any charge in 10 seconds (kWh, price, AC/DC), and Volti calculates your real kWh/100 km, cost per km, and battery State of Health. Why it's different: - 100% on-device no account, no cloud, no sign-up - Multiple cars, each with its own currency (30+) - AC vs DC cost breakdown + charts by day/week/month/year - CSV/PDF export, home-screen widget, 7 languages Free. No more spreadsheets just your charging history, finally making sense.

records.name: Live Digital Menu Boards for Restaurants
records.tagline: Real-time menu boards for any smart TV. Free to start.
records.description: Stop reprinting menus. Live Digital Menus displays your menu on any smart TV via browser URL — no hardware, no contracts. 86 items instantly, schedule daily specials, generate QR codes, and customize your branding. Free plan forever. Paid from $49/mo.

records.name: Logio
records.tagline: Manage your rentals, keep your money — for free
records.description: Logio is the simplest free web app for private landlords. Track rent and receipts, automate reminders and IRL rent revisions, and keep every lease, diagnostic and equipment in one place. 100% free — no card, no limits. Built in France, for French landlords.

records.name: FidgetDrop
records.tagline: Haptic fidget toys for your Wear OS watch
records.description: FidgetDrop turns your Wear OS watch into a small tactile fidget toy collection. Instead of another phone-first distraction app, it uses watch-native haptics, simple touch interactions, optional sound, themes, and local stats. Tap, pop, spin, flip, squeeze, or scratch through quick fidget sessions directly from your wrist. No account, no cloud sync, no social feed, and no ads.

records.name: Liftrix
records.tagline: Training timers, PR tracking & AI workouts in one app
records.description: Liftrix is the ultimate companion for people who train hard. Stop juggling 3 different apps—get your entire high-intensity toolkit in one seamless powerhouse. Timers: AMRAP, EMOM, Tabata, HIIT, and For Time Lifting: Log sets, track PRs, and see estimated 1RM Analytics: Track volume, intensity, and muscle groups AI: Instant workouts built around your available gear No accounts, no paywalls, zero friction. Core features are 100% free. Built solo. iOS first!

records.name: GOT Online
records.tagline: Visual performance analytics for game runtime optimization
records.description: GOT Online is a visual performance analytics platform designed for real-time runtime monitoring and deep performance diagnostics in game projects. It provides overall CPU/GPU/FPS tracking, memory and heap analysis, resource lifecycle inspection, and Lua performance profiling. With historical trend visualization and targeted optimization suggestions, it helps teams quickly identify bottlenecks, reduce memory risks, and improve stability across devices.

records.name: Open MobileUI
records.tagline: Your self-hosted Open WebUI, now in your pocket on iPhone
records.description: Native iPhone client for self-hosted Open WebUI. What makes it different: → Real native app, not a webview wrapper → Image uploads & file attachments → Dark mode + smart keyboard handling → Secure credential storage → Zero data collection — chats stay on your server Built by Ronas IT. We use Open WebUI internally and needed a proper mobile client — so we built one and open-sourced it.

records.name: Ramen Profitability Calculator
records.tagline: Find out exactly how many customers you need to survive
records.description: Most founders calculate ramen profitability wrong. They divide total expenses by their plan price and call it a number but that ignores payment processing fees, variable infrastructure costs, income taxes and per-user COGS all of which eat into your margin before you see a dollar. This calculator does the real math. Enter your personal survival expenses (rent, food, insurance), your fixed business overhead (hosting, tools, legal) and your unit economics (ARPU, COGS, gateway fees, tax rate).

records.name: Nodrix
records.tagline: Your own IoT cloud, deployed to your Cloudflare account
records.description: Nodrix is an open-source IoT platform you deploy to your own Cloudflare account in one click. Hardware POSTs JSON over HTTPS, realtime dashboards stream over hibernating WebSockets, automations run at the edge. No broker, no servers, no middleman.

records.name: 10 Viral TikTok Scripts
records.tagline: Done-for-you scripts. Record instantly.
records.description: Stop staring at a blank screen. These 10 TikTok scripts are plug-and-play for coaches and entrepreneurs. Topics include 5 AM Discipline, Empire Mindset, Financial Literacy, The 80/20 Rule and more. Download and record instantly.
